title: Audit executable V3 architecture rules beyond the IFX numbered-rule bindings
goal: Identify every still-active V3 architecture rule that can block the gate before asserting C1 closure.
acceptanceCriteria: The V3 Analyzer and CLI execution paths are reconciled against current IFX policy and C1b-C1k candidate rule plans.
Active missing rules and inactive policy branches are distinguished with explicit next destinations and fixture requirements.
Formal Pre, source-hash checks, isolated package regression and exact Formal Diff pass without accepting a production Profile.
